data.voice_note: Voces: Maya (examinadora de práctica) — formato Listening Part 2 real.
data.script: Maya: This is a practice test. Listen and write. … Maya: The school trip is on Thursday. Thursday, T-H-U-R-S-D-A-Y. … Maya: The bus leaves at nine fifteen. Nine one five. … Maya: Bring a packed lunch and a water bottle. The most important thing is the water bottle. … Maya: The entrance ticket costs seven soles. Seven. … Maya: And the teacher's phone number is nine-nine-two, three-four-five, six-seven-eight. … Maya: Now check your answers. You did it twice? Perfect. That's the exam way!
